from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
y=df['sales_units'].astype(float)
logy=np.log(y)
# Fit selected SARIMAX by same AIC search
specs=[]
for order in [(0,1,1),(1,1,0),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(1,1,1)]:
    for seas in [(0,1,1,12),(1,0,0,12),(0,0,0,12)]:
        try:
            fit=SARIMAX(logy, order=order, seasonal_order=seas, trend='c' if order[1]==0 and seas[1]==0 else 'n', enforce_stationarity=False, enforce_invertibility=False).fit(disp=False, maxiter=200)
            specs.append((fit.aic, order, seas, fit))
        except: pass
specs=sorted(specs, key=lambda x:x[0])
print('Best specs:')
for aic,order,seas,fit in specs[:5]: print(aic,order,seas)
best=specs[0][3]
fc=best.get_forecast(3)
summary=fc.summary_frame(alpha=0.10) # log scale
print('\nNative 90% log interval transformed:')
out=pd.DataFrame({
    'period': pd.date_range('2026-01-01', periods=3, freq='MS').strftime('%Y-%m'),
    'mean_units': np.exp(summary['mean'].values),
    'lower90': np.exp(summary['mean_ci_lower'].values),
    'upper90': np.exp(summary['mean_ci_upper'].values)
})
print(out.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x:f'{x:,.0f}'))

# Recreate val from previous run? If exists use; else no

# conformal-ish finite sample 90% quantile = ceil((n+1)*.9)/n order statistic, with n=19 => ceil18 = 18th smallest
